This repository vendors a Python engineering discipline at `'), FormattedValue(Name('agent_dir', Load()), -1), Constant('/discipline/`.
**Read `'), FormattedValue(Name('agent_dir', Load()), -1), Constant("/discipline/KERNEL.md` before writing Python here.** It is about

The thesis: *a failure must be machine-diagnosable and machine-repairable* — an agent
meeting a defect should be able to name what broke, where, in which layer, against which
contract, from the program's own output. Deep error traceability and least coupling exist
to serve that. Anything mechanically verifiable shall be mechanically verified.

```bash

Host files are now read and written with newline translation disabled and the managed block is rendered in the host file's dominant line ending, so integrating no longer rewrites every line ending in a file the project owns (blocker 1). --remove now takes back only the permission and ignore entries an install record, written at apply time to .agent/integration-record.json, proves were absent beforehand, and removes none at all when no record exists (blocker 2). Both are deliberate behaviour changes, not documentation.
